title: Pablo Tha Great releases a new track "Recipe" (feat. Snap)
htmlContent:
NYC-based artist Pablo Tha Great releases a new track called "Recipe," featuring Snap. The single "Recipe" is that fresh music from a fast raising artist that makes you pay attention to see what they will do next. He shines bright in the audio, to craft together.

Pablo Tha Great and Snap is an amazing talent who lets their talent shine to the fullest on the new song “Recipe”. Pablo Tha Great and Snap excels at both rapping and a melodic approach.They rides this hard production to perfection with plenty of swagger and charisma, as their pen shines with verses packed, with bars that hit in every line.

Stream "Recipe" by Pablo Tha Great Feat. Snap
